Name of Test Case: Ask AI to change pastor name
Action to Take: In review screen or preview banner, enter 'Change pastor name to Pastor John Mark' into Tekton edit box and click 'Change it'.
Expected Outcome: Agent identifies lead pastor in staff collection, updates name to 'Pastor John Mark', confirms with 'Changed pastor to Pastor John Mark', and increments undo count.

Name of Test Case: Reorder sections: Put service times above ministries
Action to Take: Type 'Put service times above ministries' in Tekton edit box and click 'Change it'.
Expected Outcome: Deterministic layout rule detects service_times and ministries on Home, moves service times before ministries, and confirms 'Moved Service times on Home above Ministries'.

Name of Test Case: Hide specific ministry: Hide the youth ministry
Action to Take: Type 'Hide the youth ministry' into Tekton edit input and click 'Change it'.
Expected Outcome: Agent matches 'Youth Ministry' in ministries collection, sets include: false, and replies 'Left out Youth Ministry'.

Name of Test Case: Move section to top: Move what to expect to the top
Action to Take: Type 'Move what to expect to the top' into Tekton edit input and click 'Change it'.
Expected Outcome: Layout engine moves what_to_expect section on Plan your visit page to index 0 and replies 'Moved What to expect on Plan your visit to the top'.

Name of Test Case: Update church phone number via plain text command
Action to Take: Type 'Change the phone number to (555) 019-9988' into Tekton edit input and click 'Change it'.
Expected Outcome: Agent parses new phone format, validates number, updates church contact phone field, and replies 'Changed phone to (555) 019-9988'.

Name of Test Case: Undo previous edit operation
Action to Take: Click 'Undo' button after executing a section reordering or detail change.
Expected Outcome: Restores previous draft snapshot state from undo stack, decrements undo count, and announces reversed changes.

Name of Test Case: Import website from live URL (Happy path crawl)
Action to Take: Select 'Import a website', enter 'https://cedarhollow.example.org', and click 'Start import'.
Expected Outcome: Crawler reads sitemap and top pages within robots.txt limits, extracts name, address, phone, email, and service times with 0 false conflicts, and transitions to review.

Name of Test Case: Detect conflicting service times from messy site
Action to Take: Import URL containing conflicting times: 'Sundays 9 & 11' on home page and 'Sunday 10:30am' on news post.
Expected Outcome: Draft status transitions to clarifying; displays conflict question card showing both candidate times with verbatim source quotes and page links.

Name of Test Case: Resolve service time conflict by picking candidate card
Action to Take: On service times conflict card, click candidate 'Sunday 9:00 AM, Sunday 11:00 AM' and click 'Confirm answer'.
Expected Outcome: Selected service times are locked into confirmed status with provenance attribution; builder advances to next question or review.

Name of Test Case: Prompt for missing required address and accept manual input
Action to Take: When presented with 'We could not find street address', type '100 Faith Way, Springfield, IL 62701' into input and submit.
Expected Outcome: Manual address entry is validated, saved to draft with confirmed status ('You confirmed this'), and question resolves.

Name of Test Case: Ingest PDF church bulletin and extract facts
Action to Take: Select 'Upload files', drag and drop a 2 MB weekly church bulletin PDF containing service times and pastor bio, and click 'Read files'.
Expected Outcome: Server parses PDF text streams, applies NLP regex patterns, extracts service times and staff items, and displays quotes referencing PDF filename.

Name of Test Case: Ingest church flyer image via Vision AI OCR
Action to Take: Upload church flyer image (JPEG/PNG) displaying worship schedule and logo.
Expected Outcome: Vision AI transcribes image text into machine-readable prose; rules parser extracts church schedule and logo reference.

Name of Test Case: Reject file upload exceeding 10 MB total size limit
Action to Take: Select 3 PDF files totaling 14 MB and click 'Read files'.
Expected Outcome: Client and server reject upload with error: 'Choose 1 to 5 files, each 5 MB or smaller and at most 10 MB in total.' without crashing.

Name of Test Case: Enforce robots.txt Disallow and Crawl-delay rules
Action to Take: Import site whose robots.txt disallows '/members/*' and sets 'Crawl-delay: 2'.
Expected Outcome: Crawler strictly skips disallowed URLs under /members/, applies 2-second rate limit between fetches, and notes compliance in draft notes.

Name of Test Case: Reject private IP and localhost URLs (SSRF Guard)
Action to Take: Enter 'http://127.0.0.1:8000' or 'http://192.168.1.1' into website import input and click 'Start import'.
Expected Outcome: System rejects private network URL with security validation error stating private addresses cannot be imported.

Name of Test Case: Request theme color change via natural language prompt
Action to Take: In TektonEdit input, enter 'Change site primary color theme to royal navy blue and gold' and click 'Change it'.
Expected Outcome: Builder updates site theme palette to navy blue and gold in session site theme configuration.

Name of Test Case: Request subjective marketing / theological copy generation
Action to Take: Enter 'Write a 3-paragraph welcome message emphasizing Reformed doctrine and warm fellowship' and click 'Change it'.
Expected Outcome: Agent generates and injects new custom welcome prose onto Home page.

Name of Test Case: Ingest scanned bulletin PDF without Vision AI configured
Action to Take: Upload a scanned image-only PDF bulletin while the Vision AI model is offline or unconfigured.
Expected Outcome: System automatically performs OCR and extracts service times from scanned pages.

Name of Test Case: Crawl website with 500 server error on robots.txt
Action to Take: Import website URL where robots.txt endpoint times out or returns HTTP 500 error.
Expected Outcome: Crawler skips robots.txt check and proceeds to crawl public sitemap pages.

Name of Test Case: Publish live production church without invite code
Action to Take: On preview screen, attempt to provision and deploy a new live church tenant without entering an invite code.
Expected Outcome: System provisions new church tenant and deploys public domain.
